description: Ripple at 1 A load exceeded the 30 mV limit on 14 units from one reel of output capacitors. Units otherwise pass all functional tests.

containment.action: Quarantine remaining stock of capacitor reel R-88213

rootCause.description: Capacitor ESR out of tolerance on reel R-88213.

disposition.decision: Scrap 14 units; return reel to supplier
disposition.corrective: Add ESR check to incoming inspection.
